[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Brezwalt III''' was the [[High Lady]] of [[House Mecetti]] and the leader of the [[Mecrosa Order]] during the period that climaxed in the [[Cleansing of the Nine Houses]]. She was part of a dynasty of Mecetti rulers of the [[Tapani Empire]].

==Biography==

When the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] erupted High Lady Brezwalt sought an opportunity to further her House's imperialistic ambitions in the sector. During [[Tapani Day]] festivities she [[Assassinations in the Nyssa system|ordered]] her Mecrosa Order [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] to simultaneously dispose of the leaders of five of the eight rival [[Tapani Noble Houses|houses]]. Of these only [[House Pelagia]] managed to foil the plot while the territories of Houses [[House Calipsa|Calipsa]], [[House Melissus|Melissus]], [[House Barong|Barong]] and a portion of [[House Reena/Legends|Reena]] were absorbed into [[Mecetti Province]].<ref name="KOTORCG" />

Pelagia and [[House Melantha|Melantha]] pleaded with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] to intervene but their resources were stretched by the ever intensifying war waged by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. The Sith Lady Brezwalt was poised to establish unchallenged power in the Tapani sector and establish a true Mecetti Empire when [[Jedi Shadow]]s from House Pelagia made their move. They had infiltrated every chapter of the Mecrosa order and when Exar Kun was defeated the Shadows sprung their trap and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] defeated the Mecrosa order in an event that came to be known as the Cleansing of the Nine Houses. Mecetti nobles, who were anxious to save face, turned on Lady Brezwalt.<ref name="KOTORCG" />

Brezwalt spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]], [[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]], [[Herglese]], [[Malkii/Legends|Malkite]], [[Tsi]], [[Muun (language)/Legends|Muun]] and [[Sith (language)|Sith]]. She possessed a [[Lightfoil/Legends|lightfoil]], [[Sith poison]] and a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith talisman]].<ref name="KOTORCG" />
